senses.sense_definition: Alternative spelling of <w>Macau</w>: a city, special administrative region, and peninsula in China, west of Hong Kong.

examples.text: Many tourists travel from Hong Kong to <w>Macao</w> by ferry.
The historic center of <w>Macao</w> is a popular destination for visitors.

senses.sense_definition: Alternative spelling of <w>Macau</w>: a former Portuguese colony in modern southern China between 1557 and 1999.

examples.text: The Portuguese colony of <w>Macao</w> was a major trading hub for centuries.
Historical records describe the influence of the Portuguese in <w>Macao</w> during the colonial era.

traits.comment: Refers to the historical period of Portuguese administration.

senses.sense_definition: Obsolete form of <w>macaw</w> (a type of large, colorful parrot).

examples.text: The old explorer wrote about seeing a bright <w>macao</w> in the jungle canopy.
In historical texts, the <w>macao</w> was often described as a bird of vibrant plumage.

traits.comment: This spelling is no longer in standard use.
